paris-normandy-cliffs-overnight.title: Paris · Normandy Cliffs Overnight
paris-normandy-cliffs-overnight.slogan: A 452 km loop out of Rouen food

sections.advice: Use Honfleur overnight → Lyons-la-Forêt return as clean positioning. Keep it tidy, ignore impatient traffic and save the enthusiasm for the good road ahead. The value here is not drama; it is arriving at the riding section with space, fuel and concentration intact.
